cuerpo.name: Futon 9.7.1
cuerpo.body:
### Highlights
- Mihon sources usability improved
- Performance improvements
- added option to add bulk manga to favorites
- added merge option for backup restoration
- Added an Easter egg :O
### Fixes
- Fixed the bug where Mihon sources could not be unpinned or disabled and stayed permanently pinned. Now they work the same as any other source.
- Fixed a bug where downloaded manga won't be used instead manga is fetched all times. Now if local manga present, the local manga will be used.
- hide spinner on main-frame load errors in BrowserClient
- Fix app crashes on android 6

---

## What's Changed
* chore: upgrade gradle and add compose dependencies by @onlyashd in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/58
* Fix app crashes on android 6 by @onlyashd in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/64
* fix(browser): hide spinner on main-frame load errors in BrowserClient by @jim-daf in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/68
* Fix development setup header by @APT37 in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/71
* Feature/merge imports by @LandWarderer2772 in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/73
* feat(menu): add option to add bulk manga to favorites by @LandWarderer2772 in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/75
* chore(deps): bump jwt from 2.10.2 to 2.10.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/76
* fix: downloaded manga wont fetch from source by @LandWarderer2772 in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/78
* Remove App Update Checker and Add Easter Egg by @LandWarderer2772 in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/81
* chore(deps): bump json from 1.8.6 to 2.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/77
* chore(deps): bump addressable from 2.8.8 to 2.9.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/84
* perf: fixed strictmode violations and improved performance by @LandWarderer2772 in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/83
* Sources are "unknown" fixed by @LandWarderer2772 in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/88
* fix(explore): prevent permanently pinned mihon sources by @LandWarderer2772 in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/90
* chore: update versions and parsers by @LandWarderer2772 in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/91

## New Contributors
* @jim-daf made their first contribution in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/68
* @APT37 made their first contribution in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/71
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/pull/76

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AppFuton/Futon/compare/v9.7...v9.7.1
